# Soundstripe

> > Soundstripe provides royalty-free music and sound effects for video creators, content agencies, and social media platforms including YouTube, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and Lemon8.

Soundstripe offers unlimited access to licensed music and SFX libraries with features like YouTube channel whitelisting to prevent Content ID claims. The platform serves content creators across multiple social media platforms and provides educational resources on music licensing, video production techniques, and emerging content creation trends.

## Key Topics

- Royalty-free music
- Music licensing
- Content creation
- Video production
- YouTube Content ID
- TikTok music
- Instagram Reels
- Sound effects (SFX)
- Commercial use licensing
- Social media content
- Copyright compliance
- Adobe Creative Cloud integration
- Content creation agencies
- Sound design

## Music Licensing & Copyright Guidance

- [Tips for Working with Free Music on YouTube](https://www.soundstripe.com/blogs/free-music-on-youtube-tips): Guide to finding & using copyright-safe free music on YouTube channels
- [Content Creators, Are You Falling for These 5 Stock Music Site Traps?](https://www.soundstripe.com/blogs/5-common-stock-music-site-traps): Warns video creators about common stock music licensing pitfalls
- [How to use Copyrighted Music on TikTok](https://www.soundstripe.com/blogs/how-to-use-copyrighted-music-on-tiktok): Guide to legally using copyrighted music on TikTok platform
- [Big News: YouTube Channel Listing Is Here](https://www.soundstripe.com/blogs/youtube-whitelisting-is-coming.-heres-why-it-matters-0): Announces YouTube channel whitelisting feature to prevent Content ID claims
- [Royalty Free Music for Content Creation Agencies: 4 Tips to Select the Best Royalty Free Music for Business](https://www.soundstripe.com/blogs/best-royalty-free-music-for-content-creation-agencies): Business guide: selecting quality royalty-free music for agencies

- [What Is Lemon8? A Look at TikTok's Chosen Successor & 10 Royalty Free Tracks to Kickstart Your Lemon8 Content](https://www.soundstripe.com/blogs/what-is-lemon8): Explores Lemon8 social platform & curates royalty-free tracks for content
